# Michael McClain


Alternative Investment Research Analyst and Due Diligence


As Alternative Investment Research Analyst and Due Diligence for LPL Financial, Michael is responsible for liquid alternative due diligence and alternative investment implementation across LPL’s centrally managed platform. In this role, he develops LPL Research’s preferred alternative investments solutions and provides market insights on the industry. Michael is also a voting member on the LPL Research Strategic and Alternative Investment model committees. In the past, he has also covered LPL’s hedge fund and private equity platform.


## Prior to joining LPL Financial


Michael was an analyst at BofA Global Capital Management and Boston Financial Investment Management.


## Education & Achievements


BS in Financial Economics, Saint Anselm College


Chartered Financial Analyst®


Series 7 and 66 licenses.
